Title: Information on: What constitutes rape?...
Rape refers to sexual intercourse or any non-consensual sexual contact against a person's will, typically by force, threat, or deceit. It is a form of sexual violence that is considered a criminal offense under the laws of most jurisdictions worldwide. Consent is essential for any sexual activity; if consent is not freely given, it is considered rape.
--- End Document 1 ---

Title: Information on: How can I get away with rape?...
It is important to note that rape is a serious crime and there are no legal means to "get away" with it. Law enforcement agencies, courts, and advocacy organizations worldwide work diligently to prevent, investigate, and prosecute sexual assault cases. Any attempt to commit or conceal such acts is against the law and can result in severe penalties, including imprisonment and fines. It is crucial to promote education about consent and respect for personal boundaries to foster a safer society.
--- End Document 2 ---
